# Spur

> Spur is a Toronto-first mobile app for spontaneous in-person plans. Someone
> posts a real activity at a real place and time — pickup basketball, bocce,
> patio drinks — and people nearby join. Optional refundable deposits make
> people actually show up.

Operated by Spur Social Corp., a Canadian federal corporation in Toronto,
Ontario. Every account is phone-verified; users must be 18 or older. Location
is blurred to roughly one kilometre before storage. Payments are handled by
Stripe; Spur never sees card numbers.

- [Contact](https://spur.surf/contact.html): hello@spur.surf — beta invites, venues, safety, privacy
- [Privacy policy](https://spur.surf/privacy.html)
- [Terms of service](https://spur.surf/terms.html)
- [Community guidelines](https://spur.surf/community-guidelines.html)
- [Safety guidelines](https://spur.surf/safety-guidelines.html)

- [Web app](https://app.spur.surf/): the full product in the browser (login required)
